title: Lightning Bolt: three damage is a whole player
briefing: P1 has priority in its own main phase with one Mountain and Lightning Bolt. P4 is at exactly 3 life. The other legal targets are an annoying creature (Baleful Strix), two mana creatures, P1 itself and two healthy opponents. Eliminating a player outright is worth far more than any of them.

reference.analysis: Lightning Bolt deals 3 to any target and P4 has exactly 3 life: one mana removes a whole opponent, their Serra Angel and their future turns. No creature kill compares. Bolting the Strix or a mana creature is ordinary value; bolting P2 or P3 is 3 irrelevant damage; holding the Bolt gives P4 another turn with a 4/4 flyer.

options.label: Bolt P4 for exactly lethal
options.why: Eliminates a player for one mana.

options.label: Bolt yourself
options.why: Three damage to your own face.

options.label: Bolt P2's face
options.why: Three damage to a player at 36 life changes nothing and wastes the kill.

options.label: Bolt P3's face
options.why: Three damage to a player at 29 life changes nothing and wastes the kill.

options.label: Bolt the 4/4 Serra Angel
options.why: Three damage does not kill a 4/4; the card is wasted while its controller sits at 3 life.

options.label: Bolt a creature
options.why: A fair one-for-one, but the same card eliminates P4.

otherwise.why: Holding the Bolt is safe but leaves a 3-life opponent alive when the kill is free.
